spec.title: GPU (AMD)
spec.description: AMD GPU metrics exported by sms (amd-smi): utilization, power, temperatures, VRAM, clocks, throttle state and error counters.

spec.title: GPUs up
spec.description: AMD GPUs reporting data (amd-smi parsed successfully on the last scrape).

spec.expr: count(sms_amdgpu_up{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", gpu!=""} == 1) or vector(0)

spec.title: Exporter up
spec.description: 0 when the amd-smi run failed on any selected host (the failure series carries an empty gpu label), 1 when all GPUs report.

spec.title: Throttled
spec.description: GPUs in a throttle state other than UNTHROTTLED.

spec.title: Power draw
spec.description: Total power draw in watts across the selected GPUs.

spec.title: Hotspot temp
spec.description: Highest GPU hotspot temperature in celsius.

spec.title: Memory temp
spec.description: Highest GPU memory temperature in celsius.

spec.title: VRAM used
spec.description: Video memory used in megabytes across the selected GPUs.

spec.title: VRAM total
spec.description: Total video memory in megabytes across the selected GPUs.

spec.title: GFX utilization
spec.description: Highest graphics engine utilization in percent.

spec.title: Memory utilization
spec.description: Highest memory controller utilization in percent.

spec.title: VRAM used %
spec.description: Video memory used in percent across the selected GPUs.

spec.title: Encoder utilization
spec.description: Highest video encoder utilization in percent. No sample exists while there are no encoder sessions.

spec.title: Decoder utilization
spec.description: Highest video decoder utilization in percent. No sample exists while there are no decoder sessions.

spec.title: GFX clock
spec.description: Highest graphics clock in MHz.

spec.title: Memory clock
spec.description: Highest memory clock in MHz.

spec.title: PCIe bandwidth
spec.description: Highest PCIe bandwidth in megabits per second. No sample exists without a link measurement.

spec.title: GFX utilization time share (24h)
spec.description: Share of the last 24 hours spent in each graphics utilization band (idle <10%, light 10-50%, load 50-90%, full >=90%).

spec.expr: 100 * avg_over_time(((sms_amdgpu_gfx_utilization_percent{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} >= bool 10) * (sms_amdgpu_gfx_utilization_percent{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} < bool 50))[24h:1m])

100 * avg_over_time(((sms_amdgpu_gfx_utilization_percent{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} >= bool 50) * (sms_amdgpu_gfx_utilization_percent{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} < bool 90))[24h:1m])

spec.title: VRAM used time share (24h)
spec.description: Share of the last 24 hours spent in each VRAM usage band (<25%, 25-50%, 50-75%, >=75%).

spec.expr: 100 * avg_over_time((100 * sms_amdgpu_vram_used_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} / sms_amdgpu_vram_total_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} < bool 25)[24h:1m])

100 * avg_over_time(((100 * sms_amdgpu_vram_used_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} / sms_amdgpu_vram_total_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} >= bool 25) * (100 * sms_amdgpu_vram_used_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} / sms_amdgpu_vram_total_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} < bool 50))[24h:1m])

100 * avg_over_time(((100 * sms_amdgpu_vram_used_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} / sms_amdgpu_vram_total_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} >= bool 50) * (100 * sms_amdgpu_vram_used_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} / sms_amdgpu_vram_total_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} < bool 75))[24h:1m])

100 * avg_over_time((100 * sms_amdgpu_vram_used_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} / sms_amdgpu_vram_total_megabytes{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu"} >= bool 75)[24h:1m])

spec.title: GPU inventory
spec.description: Reporting GPUs: one row per host and GPU id.

spec.expr: max by (gpu, mps_alloy_hostname) (sms_amdgpu_up{job="sms", mps_alloy_hostname=~"$hostname", gpu=~"$gpu", gpu!=""})

spec.title: GFX avg (24h)
spec.description: Average graphics engine utilization over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: GFX max (24h)
spec.description: Peak graphics engine utilization over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Power avg (24h)
spec.description: Average power draw over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Power max (24h)
spec.description: Peak power draw over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Hotspot avg (24h)
spec.description: Average GPU hotspot temperature over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Hotspot max (24h)
spec.description: Peak GPU hotspot temperature over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: VRAM avg (24h)
spec.description: Average video memory used over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: VRAM max (24h)
spec.description: Peak video memory used over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: GFX utilization vs 1h average
spec.description: Graphics engine utilization (raw) against its 1h rolling average.

spec.title: Power draw vs 1h average
spec.description: Power draw (raw) against its 1h rolling average.

spec.title: Utilization (current)
spec.description: Current graphics utilization split per GPU: busy vs idle.

spec.title: VRAM (current)
spec.description: Current video memory per GPU: used vs free.

spec.title: Utilization
spec.description: Graphics and memory controller utilization per GPU.

spec.title: Power draw
spec.description: Power draw in watts per GPU.

spec.title: GFX clock
spec.description: Graphics clock in MHz per GPU.

spec.title: Memory clock
spec.description: Memory clock in MHz per GPU.

spec.title: Encoder utilization
spec.description: Video encoder utilization in percent per GPU. No sample exists while there are no encoder sessions.

spec.title: Decoder utilization
spec.description: Video decoder utilization in percent per GPU. No sample exists while there are no decoder sessions.

spec.title: Encoder clock
spec.description: Video encoder clock in MHz per GPU.

spec.title: Decoder clock
spec.description: Video decoder clock in MHz per GPU.

spec.title: VRAM used
spec.description: Video memory used in megabytes per GPU (total shown dashed).

spec.title: VRAM used %
spec.description: Video memory used in percent per GPU.

spec.title: GPU up
spec.description: Per-GPU up state: 1 when amd-smi data was parsed, 0 after a failed run (empty gpu label).

spec.title: Throttle state
spec.description: Throttle status per GPU: 1 for any throttle state other than UNTHROTTLED.

spec.title: Single-bit ECC errors
spec.description: Single-bit ECC error rate per GPU.

spec.title: Double-bit ECC errors
spec.description: Double-bit ECC error rate per GPU.

spec.title: PCIe bandwidth
spec.description: PCIe bandwidth in megabits per second per GPU.

spec.title: PCIe replay rate
spec.description: PCIe replay counter rate per GPU.

spec.title: Hotspot temperature
spec.description: GPU hotspot temperature in celsius per GPU.

spec.title: Memory temperature
spec.description: GPU memory temperature in celsius per GPU.
